premises.text: Databases are a key piece of technology behind application infrastructure and represent an $80 billion industry.
Veritable is a predictive database that can predict missing values based on existing data.
premises.evidence_span: Veritable is a predictive database that lets you... predict missing values based on your data.

premises.text: Veritable can fill in missing values in various application domains.
premises.evidence_span: this doesn't just work for online dating... it also works across application domains.

premises.text: Veritable allows users to build applications without needing to understand complex math.
premises.evidence_span: we'd really like to give you the capability of doing these sorts of things without having to understand all the math.

premises.text: Veritable provides confidence intervals for its predictions.
premises.evidence_span: when Veritable tells you this answer, it gives you back a confidence interval.

premises.text: The future of databases can be smarter with predictive capabilities.
premises.evidence_span: we think the future can be a lot smarter.

value.text: Users can build smarter applications without needing deep technical knowledge.
value.evidence_span: if you can use SQL, you can use Veritable.

notes: No separate premises for the various application domains as they all relate to the same predictive capability.
